HDDS-11753.title: Deprecate file per chunk layout from datanode code
HDDS-11753.description: Creating one file per chunk on the datanode was the original way data was written to disk pre 1.0.0 GA. The default layout has been one file block ever since Ozone's GA release and compatibility guarantees began taking effect. I don't think there is any active Ozone data using file per chunk, and the 2.0 release would be a good vehicle to remove this code path to simplify datanode code and reduce our test matrix.
